elements.text: Data note: OISST sea-surface temperature and GPCP precipitation; maps show 2023 AMJ/JJA minus the 1982/1997/2015 strong-event composite. TNA is Tropical North Atlantic, MC is Maritime Continent, and WPWP is western Pacific warm pool. These regions are warmer, while central/eastern Pacific rainfall is weaker. How to read: SST maps show that 2023 spring-summer warming extended beyond the eastern Pacific into external basins and the warm pool; rainfall maps show that central/eastern Pacific convection did not intensify accordingly, motivating a threshold/background-state interpretation.
